issue.text: 보험사에 맞춰 보험영업 규율과 규제자본을 평가한다. 일반 사업회사의 부채·운전자본 틀은 적용 대상이 아니다.
issue.explanation: The bounded M12F suffix recognizes direct non-application forms but not '적용 대상이 아니다'. Candidate-wide review found no positive industrial-framework application and no financial refs selected. Original rejection is retained.
issue.bounded_next: Review assertion/exclusion scope generically with positive/negative/mixed-clause controls; do not whitelist this ticker or sentence.
